server_file.label: Connection: Home Assistant server file
server_file.description: File containing the Home Assistant base URL. This keeps the URL outside the declarative plugin config.

token_file.label: Connection: Home Assistant token file
token_file.description: File containing a long-lived Home Assistant token. It is read only at runtime and never stored by the plugin.

allow_insecure_tls.label: Connection: Allow insecure TLS
allow_insecure_tls.description: Skip HTTPS certificate verification. Use only for a trusted Home Assistant with a self-signed certificate.

refresh_interval.label: Connection: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_interval.description: How often to re-fetch the state of your configured entities.

browser_page_size.label: Advanced: Browser page size
browser_page_size.description: How many entities the "Add entity" browser fetches per page/Load-more click. Lower this if browsing still feels slow on a very large Home Assistant instance; there is normally no need to touch it.

bar_spacing.label: Bar: Spacing
bar_spacing.description: Gap between entity icons in the bar.
